scientific_integrity: Proof includes a self-contained successor-index lemma, explicit interval equivalence and Fibonacci parity computation; included Python tests are corroboration, not substitutes for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact census concerns contiguous cylinder indicators of cyclic integral lifts, not arbitrary observables. Uses the previously known Kesten interval criterion and elementary three-gap structures. Broader literature priority has not been independently established.
title: Three-gap census of bounded-remainder cylinders in cyclic Sturmian lifts
